ABOUT.TITLE: < about me >
ABOUT.TEXT_1: Hi, I am Kevin. I started my journey as a web developer in 2024.
ABOUT.TEXT_2: Since than I have been building and refining my skills.
ABOUT.TEXT_3: I like solving problems as part of a team and constantly learning new technologies.
ABOUT.TEXT_4: Over time, I’ve developed a solid foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript and I’m comfortable working with modern frameworks like Angular.
ABOUT.TEXT_5: I also have experience with version control systems like Git and REST-API integration.

PROJECT_1.DESCRIPTION: Join is a web-based Kanban tool with an integrated contact list that enables efficient task and team management. It is built using modern web technologies and uses Firebase as the backend for authentication, database, and real-time synchronization.
